output.scope_note: The paper reports molecular dynamics estimates of ionic conductivity for the rock-salt random substitutional crystal Li(x)Pb(1-2x)Bi(x)Te, a Li-ion conductor model, so it is in scope.

records.evidence_quote: The ionic conductivity of Li1/3 Pb1/3 Bi1/3 Te at T = 1.0 (295 K) was calculated to be 6.8 × 10−3 S/cm since unit
records.notes: Molecular dynamics simulation under an applied electric field, not an experimental measurement. Temperature is given in reduced units T = 1.0 corresponding to 295 K (T0 = 295 K). Composition is a random substitutional model; Pb and Bi are structural cations, not dopants. The same value is repeated in the Summary as 6.8 × 10−3 S/cm at 295K. No activation energy is reported.
